en.t: That year, epidemics spread throughout the world.

units.source_text: 禁中屡次发生异兆，上下人心不安。

en.t: Strange omens repeatedly appeared within the palace, and people high and low were uneasy.

units.source_text: 天空也多怪变：日月星辰，常见异光，云霞运行，亦示凶兆。

en.t: The heavens too showed many strange changes: the sun, moon, stars, and constellations often gave off uncanny light, and the movement of clouds and haze also revealed ill omens.
There were many startling events in the world.

units.source_text: 各地天文、卜易专家纷纷上书申报，其中记载着种种教人吃惊的怪事。

en.t: Astronomers and diviners from various regions submitted report after report, recording all sorts of strange and astonishing incidents.

units.source_text: 惟有源氏内大臣心中特别烦恼，认为此乃自身罪恶深重所致。

en.t: Only Genji, the Inner Minister, was especially troubled at heart, believing that all this had been caused by the gravity of his own sins.
